title: Noor and the Wardrobe
author: Sebastian Sandoval
blurb: Xanthe Underhill, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent ten years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the house sale closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
